name: United Campus Workers of Arizona
represents: higher education workers at Arizona State University (ASU), Northern Arizona University (NAU), the University of Arizona (UA), and the Maricopa County Community Colleges District (MCCCD)
note: A statewide union of faculty, staff and students with a chapter at ASU, organizing without a contract. Its page does not mention recognition by the university or collective bargaining.

name: Boston University Graduate Workers Union
represents: graduate workers at BU, consisting of teachers, researchers, graders, and more
note: The National Labor Relations Board certified SEIU Local 509 as the representative of the university's graduate student employees on December 16, 2022. The union's website says it is run by rank-and-file graduate workers rather than by SEIU Local 509 staff.

name: Graduate Labor Organization
represents: graduate student employees at Brown University
note: GLO is the graduate worker unit of Local 6516 of the American Federation of Teachers and the Rhode Island Federation of Teachers and Health Professionals (RIFTHP). Brown recognizes it under the 2023 agreement, following its certification on December 6, 2018.

name: Student Workers of Columbia
represents: all student employees who provide instructional services, including graduate and undergraduate Teaching Assistants, and all Graduate Research Assistants and Departmental Research Assistants
campuses: Morningside Heights; Health Sciences; Lamont-Doherty; Nevis
note: The union was founded as Graduate Workers of Columbia (GWC-UAW), part of UAW Local 2110; the 2021-2025 agreement names it Student Workers of Columbia, UAW, and its local SWC-UAW Local 2710. The represented unit is the one the National Labor Relations Board certified. The union's website returned a hosting error page on October 16, 2026; its history page is cited from an archived copy.

name: Cornell Graduate Students United
represents: graduate workers at Cornell
note: An affiliate of the United Electrical, Radio and Machine Workers of America (UE). The 2025 agreement covers PhD and Master's students at the Ithaca, Cornell Tech (Roosevelt Island) and Geneva campuses who receive a University stipend to teach or do research.

name: Professional Staff Congress/CUNY
represents: faculty and staff at the City University of New York and the CUNY Research Foundation
note: The union's members include CUNY's graduate assistants: the agreement's recognition article lists the Graduate Assistant A, B, C and D titles among those the PSC represents. Through the American Federation of Teachers the PSC is affiliated with the AFL-CIO. The union's pages checked do not date its certification as bargaining agent.

name: Duke Graduate Students Union
represents: all PhD students in Duke University departments housed at its campuses in Durham and Beaufort, North Carolina, employed to provide instructional or research services

name: United Campus Workers of Georgia
represents: all workers who receive a paycheck from the University System of Georgia, including staff, faculty, graduate and undergraduate assistants
note: A union open to all University System of Georgia workers, with a chapter at Georgia Tech. Georgia Tech has no collective bargaining agreement with it, and its pages describe no recognition by the Institute.

name: United Campus Workers of Virginia
represents: Virginia public higher education workers
note: A statewide union of public university workers (staff, faculty and graduate workers) rather than a union of graduate workers alone; its George Mason chapter, which graduate students helped organize, went public on May 1, 2026. Virginia public universities don't bargain collectively with it, and at the chapter's launch speakers called for state legislation expanding public workers' collective bargaining rights. No union of George Mason graduate workers alone was found.

name: Harvard Graduate Students Union
represents: student workers from all schools, campuses and departments of Harvard University
note: The union's website calls it the Harvard Graduate Student Union; the 2021 agreement, quoted here, uses Harvard Graduate Students Union.

name: Teachers and Researchers United
represents: graduate students enrolled in University PhD programs who are employed to provide instructional or research services, including teaching assistants, research assistants, and fellows
note: The union's website calls it "The JHU Graduate Workers Union" and signs itself Teachers and Researchers United – UE Local 197. The university recognizes it in the 2024-2027 agreement, after PhD workers voted for it in January 2023.

name: MIT Graduate Student Union
represents: graduate student-workers across all MIT departments and graduate programs
note: The union's members include graduate fellows, but the bargaining unit the National Labor Relations Board certified, and MIT recognizes, covers graduate students employed as research assistants, teaching assistants and instructor G's.

name: NC State Campus Workers Union: Grad Student Organizing Committee
represents: NC State University graduate worker members of UE Local 150
note: North Carolina law declares any contract between a state institution and a union acting as bargaining agent for public employees illegal, so NC State does not recognize the union; it organizes as a membership organization. The union's NC State page is part of the website of UE Local 150's university chapters. Neither page dates the chapter's founding.

name: United Council of Academics at NJIT
represents: adjunct instructors, postdocs & research employees, and graduate student RAs & TAs at NJIT
note: Founded in 2010 as the Union of Contingent Academics at NJIT, a local of the American Federation of Teachers, it joined the Rutgers Council of AAUP Chapters in 2016 as the United Council of Academics at NJIT, by the union's account; the 2015-2019 agreement with NJIT already uses that name and the Rutgers Council affiliation.

name: Northwestern University Graduate Workers
represents: graduate employees
note: The union affiliated with the United Electrical, Radio and Machine Workers of America (UE) in 2022 and also goes by NUGW-UE.

name: Graduate Student Organizing Committee
represents: NYU graduate students working across nearly every school and department as Teaching Assistants, Adjunct Instructors, Social Science Research Assistants, Graduate Assistants, and hourly employees
note: GSOC belonged to UAW Local 2110 from 2001 until August 2025, when its members voted to move to Local 7902, which also represents NYU's contract faculty.

name: Coalition of Graduate Employees – UAW
represents: graduate student teaching and research assistants from all colleges and departments across Penn State
note: The Pennsylvania Labor Relations Board certified CGE-UAW in a preliminary (nisi) order of November 21, 2025, covering teaching, research and administrative support assistants. Penn State appealed the inclusion of research assistants and said it would negotiate for teaching and administrative support assistants; no decision on the appeal was found as of October 2026. The union's site gives no local number.

name: Graduate Employees Together at the University of Pennsylvania
represents: Graduate Research and Teaching Assistants at the University of Pennsylvania
note: The union also writes its name as Graduate Employees Together – University of Pennsylvania (GET-UP). The National Labor Relations Board certified the UAW as the graduate workers' representative in case 04-RC-327396; the members formed UAW Local 5124 on ratifying their first contract.

name: Rutgers AAUP-AFT
represents: full-time faculty, graduate workers, postdoctoral associates, and EOF counselors
note: The agreement names the union the Rutgers Council of AAUP Chapters, American Association of University Professors-American Federation of Teachers, AFL-CIO. Its members voted for the dual affiliation with the AFT in 2005.

name: Stanford Graduate Workers Union
represents: PhD, Master’s (excluding MBA), and JD students who provide instructional and/or research services for the University

name: Graduate Student Employees Union
represents: teaching assistants and graduate assistants who are pursuing advanced degrees at campuses within the State University of New York (SUNY) system
note: GSEU represents graduate and teaching assistants on state-funded lines across SUNY, Stony Brook among them. No website of the union's own was found: the addresses gseu.org and www.gseu.org now serve unrelated pages.

name: Graduate Students United
represents: graduate student employees at the University of Chicago

name: Graduate Employee Organization
represents: Research Assistants, Teaching Assistants, Teaching Associates, Project Assistants, Interns, Trainees, Assistant Residence Directors, and Working Fellows at the University of Massachusetts Amherst
note: GEO is one of 27 units of an amalgamated local, UAW Local 2322, which also represents resident assistants, peer mentors and postdoctoral researchers at UMass Amherst.

name: University of Maryland Graduate Labor Union
represents: graduate assistant (GA) employees—including PhD and MS/MA teaching, research, and administrative assistants
note: An organizing campaign of the United Auto Workers (UAW), without a local number. Maryland law does not yet require the university to recognize it or bargain with it; HB 141 (2026) gives UMD graduate assistants collective bargaining rights from July 1, 2028.

name: Graduate Employees’ Organization
represents: Graduate Student Instructors (GSIs), Graduate Student Staff Assistants (GSSAs), and Graduate Student Research Assistants (GSRAs) at the University of Michigan
note: GEO is also affiliated with AFT-Michigan and the AFL-CIO. Graduate Student Research Assistants joined its bargaining unit by an election that concluded March 26, 2026.

name: UAW Local 4811
represents: Academic Student Employees (Teaching Assistants, Readers, Tutors, and Graduate Student Researchers), Postdoctoral Scholars, Academic Researchers (Specialists, Project Scientists, Researchers, and Coordinators of Public Programs), and Professional Staff
note: One local for all ten campuses and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory. Academic student employees, postdocs, academic researchers and professional staff bargain separate contracts.

name: Campaign to Organize Graduate Students
represents: graduate employees at the University of Iowa
note: COGS is a local of the United Electrical, Radio and Machine Workers of America (UE) and bargains with the Board of Regents, State of Iowa.

name: Graduate Workers Union
represents: graduate student employees
note: A grassroots union with no contract; no recognition by the university was found. No website of the union's own was found; the Underpaid@UT campaign it grew out of links to a site that no longer serves its pages.

name: United Campus Workers of Utah
represents: all employees: undergraduate workers, graduate workers, staff, and faculty
campuses: University of Utah; Utah State University
note: A union open to all campus workers, organizing without a contract. Neither the union's pages nor the University's cited pages mention recognition by the University or a collective bargaining agreement.

name: Teaching Assistants’ Association
represents: all graduate student workers at UW–Madison (TAs, PAs, RAs, GAs, and Fellows)
note: The TAA bargained contracts with the university from 1970 to 1980, and again under a 1985 state law until Wisconsin's 2011 Budget Repair Bill restricted collective bargaining for public employees. Graduate assistants' pay is now set by university policy, with no collective bargaining agreement.

name: UAW Local 4121
represents: Academic Student Employees, Postdocs, and Research Scientists/Engineers

name: Virginia Tech Graduate Labor Union
represents: the graduate workers of Virginia Tech
note: A local branch of the Virginia Education Association and the National Education Association. Its membership is open to all eligible graduate and professional students at Virginia Tech. No collective bargaining agreement covers Virginia Tech graduate assistants, and the union works alongside United Campus Workers of Virginia.

name: Local 33–UNITE HERE
represents: graduate teachers and researchers
note: Local 33's predecessors were TA Solidarity and the Graduate Employees and Students Organization (GESO). It is affiliated with UNITE HERE.
